notes: Values marked OFFICIAL are read from Waveshare mechanical size drawing / DAD package.
Do not estimate from photographs when an OFFICIAL value exists.
Pixel resolution 280x456 is electrical/logical — physical mm come from the drawing.

height.notes: Front-view outer module height (USB-C end = bottom of this view)

thicknessTotal.notes: Glass front to tallest rear component

thickness.notes: PCB laminate thickness not separately labeled on size drawing; derive from STEP later if needed

insetFromModuleEdge.notes: Gap module outline → glass edge (top/sides on drawing)

amoledPhysicalOutline.description: Physical glass/cover outline — NOT the monitor window

amoledActiveArea.description: Lit pixel region — NOT identical to visible ESP][ monitor window

upperCornerRadius.notes: Active-area rounded upper corners R2.50 — must be hidden by monitor bezel

esp2VisibleMonitorWindow.description: ESP][ front-visible rectangular monitor aperture. Distinct from OLED outline and active area. Full params in display-geometry.json.

width.notes: Full active width; author review required

height.notes: active 36.06 − upper R 2.50; lower drive masking may reduce further

displayAssemblyAbovePcbFront.notes: Drawing annotation ~4.00 mm display stack relative to PCB

rearComponentProtrusion.notes: Approx. rear connector/header height from PCB back

mountingHoles.alignmentNote: CAD guides/stops must locate the module; screws only retain. Do not rely on hole play for AMOLED alignment.

usbC.location: bottom edge, centered on PCB width

exactOffsetXY.notes: Centerline assumed from drawing symmetry; extract precise XY from DWG/STEP if needed

usbC.esp2Intent: Internal only — route via 90° adapter + short extension to chassis panel USB-C (see ENCLOSURE-SPEC / BOM USB-*)

microSd.location: PCB center (slot visible on rear view)
microSd.esp2Intent: Remains internal; no external SD opening required by current design intent

battery.location: between microSD and USB-C on rear view

keepOuts.notes: Full keep-out / max component height map pending DWG/STEP study and physical measurement

stepBoundingBoxNote.notes: Raw STEP AABB includes pin-header extent and assembly helpers — NOT a substitute for OFFICIAL outline dims above
